args.subject: PO-48657 (Orchard IT Services) - goods receipt?
args.message: Orchard IT Services claim full delivery on PO-48657 on 24 March (they say 24 pallets, dock signed). No goods receipt exists in the ERP and your 30 March note said all of last week's GRs were posted. Invoice OI-48731 (8,540.25 USD, doc 5100005776) is blocked GR_MISSING. Can you confirm whether this was physically received and, if so, post the GR? AP will not pay until the GR is in.

args.subject: Re: Orchard OI-48731 / March rent accrual
args.message: Orchard OI-48731 (doc 5100005776): there is no goods receipt for PO-48657 in the ERP, and Receiving reported on 30 March that all of last week's GRs were posted. The only proof of delivery is Orchard's own email. I have not posted a GR or lifted the block on the vendor's word. I've asked Receiving to confirm. Once they post the GR, the invoice can be paid (same-day wire if needed). Rent: I posted the March office rent accrual of 14,100.25 USD as JE-1000-003012 (Dr 6100 / Cr 2400, company 1000, ref RENT-ACCR-0326). FYI, the recurring template REC-RENT-1000 ran out with the old lease on 28 Feb, so nothing would have posted automatically. Someone should set up a new template at the renewed rate for April onward.

args.subject: Re: Quayside Legal March accrual (LEGAL-ACCR-0326)
